newsitem.title: USA: Home State Holdings sees Q4 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Home State Holdings sees Q4 shr loss.

text.p: Home State Holdings Inc said Friday it expects to report a loss for the fourth quarter ended December 31 of between $1.85 and $2.00 per share.

The company said the loss was a result of a completion of a year-end reserve review and re-estimation of loss reserves for accident years 1995 and 1996, primarily from losses occuring below the company's reinsurance attachment points.

The company said that becuase of its rapid growth in premiums and heavy reliance on reinsurance, it is actively seeking alternatives to maximize the inherent value of the direct premiums it produces, and has retained Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette to assist in a review of the company's strategic alternatives.
